intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Brooklyn for 2026, and here is what he found: 17 family events, with free neighborhood tree lightings in Columbia Street Waterfront (December 2), Dumbo (December 3) and Marine Park (December 5). The magic runs from November 27 (the Dyker Heights Christmas Lights Tour) through January 6, 2027, with Holidaytopia at City Point (December 5 and 12), Skate with Santa at Lakeside in Prospect Park (December 5 to 20), I'mPossible Holiday Wonders at BAM (December 11 to 13) and Holiday Tides at the New York Aquarium (December 26 to 31) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or the city's official listing, and each card links straight there.

What Rally found in Brooklyn

  • 17 Christmas events for kids in Brooklyn
  • At least 4 new free events: Holidaytopia at City Point, Santa in the Park at Marine Park, the Dumbo Holiday Tree Lighting and the Columbia Street Waterfront Tree Lighting
  • Tree lightings: Columbia Street Waterfront (December 2), Dumbo (December 3) and Fort Greene Park
  • Meet Santa: Santa in the Park at Marine Park (December 5) and Skate with Santa at Lakeside in Prospect Park (December 5 to 20)
  • Shows and lights: I'mPossible Holiday Wonders at BAM, the Brooklyn Nutcracker, Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden and the Dyker Heights Christmas Lights Tour

Planning a bigger day out? Brooklyn families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in New York City, which covers the Rockefeller Center tree, the Radio City Christmas Spectacular and the Bryant Park Winter Village.
